pages.text: The Scythe is a broad reaping tool. It is effective on plants and attacks enemies in a wide range. Right-clicking crops or sugarcane harvests and replants all fully grown plants in the area.
$(l)Properties$()$(br2)- Requires a Tool Forge$(br)- Area-of-effect attack$(br)- 3x3 area harvesting$(br)- Right-click: harvest and replant
